description: Pass the tasks your agents handed each other (e.g. the result of Offhand list_todos) and get back which are stalled or failing and what to do. A task is stalled when it is claimed (in_progress) or handed over but untouched for stall_minutes, and failing when it is blocked or has failed fail_limit times. Ladder: nudge the assignee, nudge again, then reassign to a backup agent (or ask the person). Pro acts: records each nudge with a cooldown so nobody is pinged twice, and POSTs the nudge to the agent's webhook if you give one. Free watch-only takes no action and returns would_nudge / would_reassign. It never changes a task in Offhand itself and never takes a task another agent holds; reassigning returns an Offhand add_task call for your agent to make.

backup_agent.description: Default agent to hand stalled work to.

board.description: A stable name for this task list, e.g. "offhand" or "team-ops". Cooldowns and the escalation ladder are tracked per board.

fail_limit.description: Failures before a task counts as failing. Default 2.

nudges_before_reassign.description: Nudges before suggesting a reassign. Default 2.

stall_minutes.description: Minutes without activity before a task counts as stalled. Default 60.

assignedTo.description: Agent the task was handed to (alias: assignee).

backup.description: Agent that may take it over (optional).

idle_minutes.description: Instead of updatedAt: minutes since the last activity.

status.description: Offhand status: open, in_progress, blocked, done, need_review (also accepts todo, claimed, failed).

updatedAt.description: ISO time of the last status change or note (alias: updated_at).

webhooks.description: Optional map of agent name to an https URL that wakes it (Pro posts nudges there).

name: scan_handoffs
